messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've decided something,
{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I've decided
that I need bugs. {01 00 00 0a 00}Lots.
See, what I want is to fill
my room with bug cages and{07 11 00}
study their ways{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen midagi otsustanud,
{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma otsustasin,
et ma vajan putukaid. {01 00 00 0a 00}Palju.
Vaata, ma tahan täita oma
toa putukapuuridega ja{07 11 00}
uurida nende kombeid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} I've gotta say
that I like having bugs
in my house...
Right now, my decor really
reflects my interests. It's
fascinating, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} pean ütlema,
et mulle meeldib, kui majas
on putukaid...
Praegu peegeldab mu kodu
tõesti mu huvisid. See on
lummav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}, I've
noticed something strange
lately, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
When you've got a lot of
bugs in your room, they
act like an air freshener!
{07 0a 00}Everything smells better
with a beetle in your
boudoir!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule, {04 1f 00}, ma olen
viimasel ajal midagi veidrat
märganud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Kui sul on toas palju
putukaid, käituvad nad
nagu õhuvärskendaja!
{07 0a 00}Kõik lõhnab paremini, kui
magamistoas on üks
põrnikas!
